backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual interest expense and revenue are read from raw SEC Companyfacts tags and are known only by filed date (<= signal date). Current and prior annual interest-expense values are matched to same-period annual revenue by fiscal year end. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts annual interest-expense burden relief (interest expense/revenue falling year over year), paired with liquid SPY-relative leadership, may identify financing-pressure relief and operating leverage winners whose next-open 10-day continuation beats generic debt text and static quality-factor sources.

2_history_check.exp-20260615-001: SEC deleveraging/liquidity repair text was rejected despite all three core windows improving because it did not beat the accepted SEC RS20 comparator. This run uses structured Companyfacts numbers, not text spans or debt/liquidity phrase lists.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-016: Operating leverage acceleration was rejected on window/drawdown and accepted-comparator gates. This run tests financing-cost burden relief rather than revenue-vs-operating-income growth spread.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-003: R&D intensity acceleration was rejected on two window regressions and concentration. This run uses a balance-sheet/income-statement relief field, not innovation-spend intensity.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Declining interest burden is a structured PIT SEC signal of financing pressure relief, distinct from generic debt-repair text and R&D or operating-leverage fields. It should work only when price leadership confirms absorption. Main risks are sparse interest-expense tags, stale annual facts, and overlap with already accepted quality/momentum comparators.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual interest-expense/revenue pair, missing prior annual comparison pair, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual interest-burden relief gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
